title: Chapter 568
paragraphs: Chapter 568
Episode 147. The King of the Black Sea, Gleak (12)
The reason he could avoid having his throat cut by Ron's blade at that moment was probably due to the spirit energy strengthened by chaos.
Jin's reaction was faster than he could believe. It was definitely impossible before to create distance when Ron, in full speed, ambushed him.
A hot stream of blood trickled down his throat.
He finally met the most reliable and strong ally in this subspace, but he tried to kill him without hesitation.
The fact was much more shocking than the sense of crisis that he almost died. Moreover, what about what Ron said?
"Why was Dante eaten instead of you!"
Ron's voice, screaming again, was colder than any dagger, scratching Jin's inner self.
Guilt, the emotion that has been tormenting Jin since the start of the Sword Emperor War. The guilt he had been trying to hide to focus on the fight boiled up hard like a purulent peritonitis.
"Captain Ron is not himself right now. No matter how desperate, he's not someone who would say that......"
He himself had just experienced his body and mind being eroded by chaos. He was barely suppressing the madness that surged after the pain that trampled his body had passed.
"Judging by the erosion of the pupils, Captain Ron must have gone through the same process as me. Definitely......"
Suddenly!
At that thought, a sense of nausea surged. A disgusting and nauseating mass seemed to clog his throat, making it difficult to endure.
It was due to 'doubt'.
Although he was eroded, what Ron is saying now might be the true feelings hidden deep within him.
Considering the recent tragedy that Hyran went through, it was entirely possible. Anyone would want to resent.
And what was even harder for Jin to bear.
The madness of chaos that began to infiltrate his mind, and the lust for life that stemmed from it, began to target Ron.
Whether Ron's resentment towards him now is sincere or not.
Jin believed that he had no right to harbor hostility towards Ron. After Dante disappeared, it was Ron who tried to save him in the end.
Ron, in his stance, pointed his sword at Jin.
Somewhere in the blade of the black-stained Rasheed, it seemed as if the real energy of Ron, which shone brilliantly before Gleak woke up, was seeping in.
That invisible light was guiding Jin.
If he had not seen the effort he made to save Hyran, to let him live. Jin would have simply become a fighter against Ron.
Jin slowly raised Bradamante and found his center.
The madness swirling in his brain was gradually subsiding.
Jin had come to think that the current Ron is no different from the spirit energy or the blood of the spirit warriors that had saved him from the erosion earlier.

Just as the spirit energy and the blood of the spirit warriors helped control the spirit energy strengthened by chaos, the light named Ron Hyran was causing a great leap in Jin's inner self once again.
He had overcome the erosion of the flesh and shaken off the madness of his mind.
In a way, Jin had achieved growth, transcendence, within this subspace. Even the suspicion that this too might be a trick of Gleak was fading.
Overcoming one wall means being able to see beyond it. In this newly reached area, Jin could not feel any intention of Gleak.
Jin saw it clearly.
The moment Gleak dragged Jin into the subspace, he had predicted that it was only a matter of time before the dirty power of Soldierlet would come to an end.
That's why he said that all the opportunities given to Jin had disappeared. No matter how much the energy of the Soldierlet, it was too weak to resist him.
But that was not the only thing that exceeded expectations.
He did not call Ron here.
"Now it's my turn to help Captain Ron."
He had no idea how to help.
However, Jin decided to accept Ron's anger. Now that the chaos has strengthened the spirit energy, he thought he might be able to properly exchange swords with Ron to some extent.
Until Ron's anger subsided a little.
Jin decided to fight him.
Crack-!
Ron's charging sword fell on Jin's forehead.
There was still no hesitation in Ron's sword. Jin no longer felt hurt by this fact and firmly clashed his sword.
"Why wasn't it you!"
No matter how much he was heartbroken and sad.
He could not compare to the pain Ron had gone through. Therefore, it was impossible for him to show any more sadness than that.
It would be an insult to Ron's suffering.
The battle started fiercely. Both are face to face with their swords without backing down.
However, Jin, who was persistently swinging his sword, never succeeded in an attack. It was not because he could not bear to cut or stab Ron, but because he did not have the leisure to do so.
Instead, Ron, who was unilaterally attacking, also could not break through Jin's defense.
"Dante, give the kid back......!"
Silently, as if undergoing asceticism, Jin was enduring the human being named Ron Hyran. In the abyss, the fight between the two continued lonely.
As it has been since entering the subspace, it was impossible to tell how time was passing.

Nevertheless, it couldn't have been for a very long time, but Jin felt as if he had aged a bit. To embrace the sorrow of a giant named Ron, he had to become even stronger, so this strange sense of aging was inevitable.
Ron would have needed someone too.
Someone who would allow him to cry freely and vent his anger limitlessly, someone he desperately needed. So whether it's resolved or not...... just try it that way.
He should have been told to express his anger, not to save Jin or for revenge, but purely for himself.
Tears hotter than the blood flowing from his neck were running down Jin's cheeks.
Despite losing everything, Ron overcame death for his grandson, for his friend, simply because his duty was overwhelmingly heavy.
The same was true of Jin's inevitable choice to resurrect Ron with the spirit stone, which he hated so much.
Neither of them made a choice for themselves in this war.
They only raised their swords for others.
And the reason Jin can still fight for him, not himself, up to this moment unlike Ron, is because he has gone through less pain.
As a result, Jin was comforting himself.
Only now did it seem like he was genuinely empathizing with his own pain, with Ron's pain. He couldn't control the tears flowing so much that his vision blurred.
Humans are born to see themselves through others. Now Jin was recognizing the sorrows he didn't know about himself through Ron.
But that does not help the battle.
Ron's sword, which was narrowly blocked, was getting closer and closer. If it continues like this, soon, Ron's sword will cut Jin.
An afterimage wound was forming.
Perhaps because the chaos that colored Ron's sword during the battle became darker, the wound inflicted by Rashid spat out black blood as if poisoned.
The spirit energy and the blood of the spirit warriors could not suppress Ron's chaos. Since it's not real poison even if it's like poison, the energy of the poison resist did not show any reaction.
Death was imminent.
But what Jin fears is not death. Jin was afraid of the fact that Ron might not return before his life is over.
Thud!
Finally, Ron's sword pierced Jin's abdomen.
The moment he twists the knife or cuts it to one side, Jin will face death.
'No, maybe already... I don't know if it's over.'
The chaos trapped in the afterimage wound caused a serious toxic reaction. Needless to say, the energy of chaos that penetrated the abdomen.
Ron stood still, his head bowed.
If Jin had the strength to move just once, he was defenseless enough to be easily stabbed with the sword he held.
However, Jin was only able to keep his grip on the sword, he couldn't even move a single finger.
Soon Jin was able to face Ron's face, who raised his head.
Black tears were flowing from his eyes dyed in chaos.
"Ron... please..."
Without an answer, only the sound of sobbing was heard.
Ron's hand holding the hilt of the sword was shaking.
It was because he was resisting the energy of chaos whispering to twist the sword and finish Jin off.
Jin didn't add any words to that sight. He didn't say that he had to overcome it, to stop it, or that he shouldn't do it.
He just waited. So that he could ascend the last step of the abyss.
The reason why Ron, reaching the last moment, was delaying this death he had so longed for, was for the same reason as Jin.
Just as Jin had gained enlightenment by seeing the light of the human called Ron Hyeran, Ron also recognized from Jin, who wielded the sword for himself until the end.
Himself who became a monster engulfed in sorrow.
"You may... resent me."
Ron's pupils shook.
He was slowly pulling out Rashid, who was piercing Jin.
Ron's blackened pupils began to find their color, and as soon as his sword was retrieved, Jin fell down, vomiting blood.
Chaos spread throughout his body like poison, and the bleeding and internal injuries were severe, so he would certainly die.
Jin, however, felt like he wouldn't die.
Ron was staring at the air without looking down at Jin.
In that air, there was something... that was not visible to someone else on the battlefield, not visible to Jin's eyes.
There were two people in the world who could see it.
Sirone Run Kandel.
And just now, having entered the realm of the Spirit Ascension.
A white light that only Ron Hyeran could see filled the air. Ron remained motionless for a while, his gaze fixed on the light.
When you go over the wall, you see what's on the other side.
As soon as he faced the light of the Spirit Ascension, Ron was able to realize a few facts that he didn't even think of, or just hoped for.
Jin couldn't see the light directly, but he felt it. It's the fact that Ron finally took the last step to defy fate.
No more murky energy of chaos was coming from Ron.
'I see... hope.'
Ron reached out to the light of the Spirit Ascension, and Jin passed out with a smile.
